intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Washington for 2026, and here is what he found, with 4 new events added to the live page: the Downtown Washington Christmas Parade (December 12), Canonsburg's Old Fashioned Christmas (December 4 and 5), Christmas on High Street in Waynesburg (November 28) and Christmas Around the World at the NSS Heritage Museum in McMurray (November 28), alongside the Santa Trolley, the 4th Annual Holiday Concert and Breakfast with Santa already listed. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Washington

  • 3 new free events: Downtown Washington Christmas Parade, Canonsburg's Old Fashioned Christmas and Christmas Around the World at the NSS Heritage Museum
  • Parades and tree lightings: Washington parade (December 12), Canonsburg tree lighting (December 4 and 5), Waynesburg tree lighting (November 28)
  • Meet Santa: Canonsburg's North Pole photos (December 4 and 5)
  • Trains: Canonsburg's Christmas train display and the Santa Trolley at the Pennsylvania Trolley Museum

Planning a bigger day out? Washington families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Pittsburgh, which covers Kennywood Holiday Lights, Phipps Conservatory and the Pittsburgh Zoo.
